performance.cost_breakdown: catalog parts $831, filament 1.59 kg $40, fasteners $21, fabricated/other $145 (380 x 290 x 3 mm 5052 aluminium deck, laser cut (~$64); 2020 aluminium extrusion, 0.75 m (~$9); 420 x 40 x 6 mm aluminium flat bar shoulder yoke (~$12); upper_arm fabric sleeve (in the cover kit); forearm fabric sleeve (in the cover kit); foam-filled fabric mitten on a printed wrist plate (in the cover kit); upper_arm fabric sleeve (in the cover kit); forearm fabric sleeve (in the cover kit); foam-filled fabric mitten on a printed wrist plate (in the cover kit); sewn white ripstop body cover with zip and foam lining, about 2 m^2 (~$60); power switch, 15 A fuse, wiring)

assumptions: Baymax's inflatable vinyl body is a sewn ripstop cover with a foam-lined zip, bought or sewn, with negligible structural role; it hangs on the shoulder yoke and hides a 4WD skid-steer base. It is not inflated, so it does not cushion like the film's.

Structure: 2020 aluminium extrusion spine and a 6 mm aluminium shoulder yoke; arms are four servos each (shoulder yaw, shoulder pitch, elbow, wrist) splayed 25 deg so they clear the belly; the hands are printed mittens covered with the same fabric.
Each arm is sized as mounted to lift 0.1 kg in the mitten at full reach; the tipping check includes both arms stretched forward with that payload.
The head turns on one pan servo; a camera looks out between the eyes through a 12 mm hole.
